title: red overhaul
description: A texture pack i made giving most UI and some items a red overhaul
body:
## a texture pack i made that overhauls most of the ui's and some items to give it a red overhaul

this re-textures the survival inventory, xp bar, armor bars, outlines every ore making them easier to spot, it also makes the elytra red in its worn and item form and it also gives every UI a red outline as seen in the gallery. it also shows a custum crosshair.

**Note: this project is currently only for 1.21.11 I will update this if I decide to add any more version**
